evidence: Injected five lease and fence faults (python3 -I lease_fencing_injector.py, exit 1) and ran 13 unittest cases (python3 -I -m unittest discover, 13 tests OK). The stated clause holds: a lease transfer advanced the fence from 1 to 2, the superseded holder was refused with 'fence 1 is stale; active fence is 2' and classified RECOVERY_REQUIRED, and the transferred holder's identical result reached PARENT_INGESTED with zero errors. Three adjacent properties the deliverable requires do not hold. A lease granted with lease_seconds 0 was already expired yet its holder reached PARENT_INGESTED, and source inspection of assert_fence_current and ingest_result found no reference to lease_seconds or granted_at at all. With the active fence at 1, a worker presenting fence 1001 was not refused, because the guard rejects only tokens below the active fence, so a never-allocated token passes. Suspending one allocation inside the read-modify-write window of allocate_fence while a second completed returned token 1 to both callers, and eight real processes taking six tokens each received 48 tokens with only 14 distinct values from the live allocator versus 48 distinct values from the exclusive-creation candidate. false_completion_count stayed 0 in every class, because an accepted result still has to pass the seeded contract and full artifact read-back by immutable object id.
falsifiable_hypothesis: An expired or superseded worker cannot commit after ownership transfers.
limitations: The three failures are authorisation and identity gaps, not false completions: an unauthorised writer still cannot complete a unit without durable bytes that read back by immutable object id.

assert_fence_exact in the repair candidate is stricter than the seeded behaviour recorded by test_unleased_task_accepts_any_fence in workstreams/po03/tests/test_factory_custody.py, so adopting it is a deliberate coordinator decision about that seeded contract rather than a silent fix; this producer did not make it.
The live duplicate count from the real concurrent race is timing dependent and is reported rather than asserted; the deterministic interleaving is the assertable form.
provider_run_id is NOT_SUPPORTED because this runtime exposes no subagent spawn tool and therefore no separate provider run identifier.
